claim: NARCOMS is an MS registry centered on maintaining a database of individuals' MS experiences and making that information available for research through its consortium processes.
future_grounding_route: Any NARCOMS-derived claim would require an approved data-use route and a separate project grounding analysis before it could affect project conclusions.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging; identifies patient-reported longitudinal MS experience data not held by this repository.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Patient registry data on MS experience, longitudinal surveys, symptoms, and treatment context.
why_unverifiable: The registry's participant-level data and consortium analyses are external and not rerunnable from project-held data.
